question:
Select the figure that will come next in the following figure series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4694576895cb8e380157e89e81a5f2e1ba00867e395aaa8d585149a8437ec95c.png]
solution:
The figure that will come next in the following figure series is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/da197159a13a608cf930b38031eb8cd29919f652d6b39b0c4fb12707b9d88f4d.png] 

**Figures at odd position:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aa2984f0ab459ead56999539429b5a97473d033b748f555f58c9112b7f53721e.png] 

Square shape changes its position by shifting 180º clockwise direction. Number of arrow increases by 2 as we move along the series. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/01414ac4846107ec34f264e92c32efc358ddb5306a06dcd317bd6d87cccecaa7.png] figures decreases by 2 as we move along the series.

Figures at even position:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/64754ead1bf9500926542380389a5c96c7f11971ccf4901244bb3470936d66db.png] 

Pentagon shape changes its position by shifting 180º anti-clockwise direction. Number of arrow increases by 2 as we move along the series. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/01414ac4846107ec34f264e92c32efc358ddb5306a06dcd317bd6d87cccecaa7.png] figures decreases by 2 as we move along the series.

Hence, '**option 4**' is the correct answer.
